statement: For the two positive signed odd-return maps, S_-(2n+1)=S_+(n), and S_+(2n-1)=S_-(n) at n>=1. Their complete one-generation unit-source coefficients have sum at least 9/7 at every unit target. At every a=4 mod 27 the complete depth-two coefficients are K_2^+(a)=12076/29127 and K_2^-(a)=7988/29127; their sum is below one. Let M_2^s(a) be the actual reciprocal mass of positive odd sources prime to three at exactly two fixed-sign returns. For every odd a>=2, M_2^s(a)<=K_2^s(a)/(a-5/4); this mass is finite and its ordinary real reciprocal series converges. For all t>=0 and a=31+54t, a*(M_2^+(a)+M_2^-(a))<3/4. Unique inverse-exponent pairs enumerate actual ancestors without multiplicity, and the complete infinite sums are kernel-checked. Iterating the paired one-step operator introduces mixed-sign paths. No summability over all depths, improved Juggler pressure rate or termination follows. Independent review and advisory statement coverage pending.
